title: Test-Time Adaptation for EEG Foundation Models: A Systematic Study under Real-World Distribution Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2604.16926v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models have shown strong potential for learning generalizable representations from large-scale neural data, yet their clinical deployment is hindered by distribution shifts across clinical settings, devices, and populations. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a promising solution by enabling models to adapt to unlabeled target data during inference without access to source data, a valuable property in healthcare settings constrained by privacy regulations and limited labeled data. However, its effectiveness for EEG remains largely underexplored. In this work, we introduce NeuroAdapt-Bench, a systematic benchmark for evaluating test-time adaptation methods on EEG foundation models under realistic distribution shifts. translated_title: 脑电基础模型的测试时适应：真实世界分布偏移下的系统性研究
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）基础模型在从大规模神经数据中学习可泛化表示方面展现出强大潜力，但其临床部署受到临床环境、设备和人群间分布偏移的阻碍。测试时适应（TTA）提供了一种有前景的解决方案，使模型在推理过程中无需访问源数据即可适应未标记的目标数据，这在受隐私法规和有限标记数据约束的医疗场景中具有重要价值。然而，其针对EEG的有效性仍未得到充分探索。在本工作中，我们引入了NeuroAdapt-Bench，一个系统性的基准测试，用于评估在现实分布偏移下EEG基础模型的测试时适应方法。我们评估了来自其他领域的代表性TTA方法，涵盖多个预训练基础模型、多样化的下游任务以及异构数据集。
tldr: 本文提出了NeuroAdapt-Bench基准，首次系统评估了脑电基础模型在现实分布偏移下的测试时适应方法，填补了该领域的研究空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NeuroAdapt-Bench, the first systematic benchmark for evaluating test-time adaptation methods on EEG foundation models under real-world distribution shifts, filling a critical research gap.
